criteria.description: State the real invariant: the wrapper preserves the field set; casing follows React/JSX convention via the generator's MAPPED_PROPS table, over DELIVERABLE (attributed or property-only) fields specifically.
criteria.evidence: ADR §'The wrapper prop-name invariant this ADR omitted (#189)', paragraph 'The invariant this ADR should always have stated': states field-SET preservation over deliverable fields and the React/JSX casing exception via MAPPED_PROPS; satisfies spec.md SC-001 (grep for MAPPED_PROPS/readOnly/autoComplete/inputMode).
criteria.notes: Verified against the shipped script (EXPECTED_NON_PROP_FIELDS, :123/:783-793) and against sk-form-input.errorMessage as the deliverable-vs-non-deliverable boundary case; pre-merge squad (PR #190) caught the first draft's omission of this boundary.

criteria.description: Record the sk-form-input worked example: readonly->readOnly, autocomplete->autoComplete, inputmode->inputMode.
criteria.evidence: ADR §'The worked example — sk-form-input': table naming all three renamed fields (readonly/autocomplete/inputmode); satisfies spec.md SC-002.
criteria.notes: Verified against packages/react/src/SkFormInput.d.ts and the manifest.

criteria.description: Record that MAPPED_PROPS is not exported, that the gate parses it from the installed bundle (fail-closed: exact-compare, narrower fallback on read failure) rather than mirroring it by hand.
criteria.evidence: ADR §'The table is a package internal, not a contract this repo controls': states MAPPED_PROPS is not exported, the gate parses the installed bundle, and the fail-closed read/exact-compare/narrower-fallback pattern, plus the index.js-vs-index.cjs packaging note.
criteria.notes: Verified by reading loadReactPropRenameMap() end to end and diffing node_modules/@wc-toolkit/react-wrappers/dist/index.js against dist/index.cjs (byte-identical MAPPED_PROPS in 1.2.7).

criteria.description: Assess whether consolidating REACT_PROPS and the rename table is worth it; record a verdict with reasoning, and flag to the operator rather than implementing a gate-behaviour change unilaterally.
criteria.evidence: ADR §'Should REACT_PROPS and the rename table be one mechanism?' plus 'Verdict: not worth consolidating now': explicit verdict with reasoning, flagged to the operator rather than implemented; satisfies spec.md SC-003.
criteria.notes: Verdict: not worth consolidating now (see ADR). Overlap measured at 7/12 REACT_PROPS entries (58%). Not implemented in code per this mission's scope.

criteria.description: State the contract-doc obligation for future element authors, using sk-form-input's contract as the worked example, and be honest that it is unenforced guidance rather than a gate mechanism.
criteria.evidence: ADR §'What a future element author must know, before naming a field': states the disclosure obligation, that it is unenforced guidance (not a gate mechanism), and that it already failed once on sk-form-input's own contract doc; stale contract-doc drift filed as spec-kitty-design#191 rather than silently left.
criteria.notes: Pre-merge squad (PR #190) found the obligation as first drafted was a bare 'must' with no enforcement mechanism; revised to state this plainly and to file spec-kitty-design#191 for the contract doc's own drift.
